item.title: Uses
item.description:
Whenever I’m faced with a decision on what software to use, I always try to find similar tools for comparison’s sake before picking one. In the past, I’ve used alternativeto and stackshare. Just recently, I found out about the whole /uses list. Crowdsourcing what other developers are using is a good way to pick up some new and better tools, I think.

So, I thought I would contribute by making my own /uses!

Editor

Visual Studio Code - No surprises here. Still a solid editor in the age of AI.

Extras

  • Dracula - My dark theme of choice.
  • JetBrains Mono - My favorite font. I even have font ligatures on, why not?
  • Hadolint - Lint those Dockerfiles.
  • Spell Checker - Natural language comments and variable names should be spellchecked!
  • RGBDS Z80 - A language extension for programming in Game Boy assembly. Pretty cool that this exists!

Desktop Apps

  • Firefox - Switched from Chrome a few years ago and have not looked back.
  • iTerm2 - As far as I’m concerned, THE terminal for macOS.
  • toggl track - For time-keeping and project tracking. Also has a handy pomodoro timer.
  • 1Password - Currently in the process of migrating from LastPass. I prefer 1Password’s client and overall features.

Hardware

MacBook Air M2 2022 - Incredibly lightweight and blazing fast for my use case. At this point, I don’t encounter issues with the Apple Silicon chipset, which is a big improvement from when it first launched.

Misc.

Code Formatters/Linters

  • Shellcheck - This tool has made bash (simple) scripting a tolerable idea.
  • Black - Python code formatter which is auto-installed in any new Python project I start.
  • semi-standard - Big fan of StandardJS… except for the whole semi-colon thing.

My macOS dotfiles

  • rnegron/dotfiles - Can’t leave home without them.

This Website

Like it says on the sidebar, this website is built and served using a combination of Github Pages, Hugo, Route53 and Markdown!

item.title: Open Source Projects
item.description:
Here are my open-source projects as well as some projects I’ve contributed to.

WiiNewsPR

Fork of the WiiLink24 News Channel for the Nintendo Wii console, adding support for PR based news.

Tech Highlights:

  • Golang
  • AWS Lambda

django-athm

Django app for handling ATH Móvil payments.

Tech Highlights:

  • Django Templates
  • Available on PyPI and Django Packages

dino-gb

A Nintendo Game Boy port of the Google Chrome T-Rex game. Works on real hardware

Tech Highlights:

  • C Language
  • GBDK

misresultados-tools

Tooling for programmatically interacting with misresultados.com (the most popular healthcare results platform in Puerto Rico)

Tech Highlights:

  • NodeJS
  • Firefox Extension
  • CLI available on npm

noticias-pr

A command-line interface for reading the latest from local news sites in Puerto Rico.

Tech Highlights:

  • NodeJS
  • Web scraping
  • Available on npm

cc-api

An open-source API for Caribbean Cinemas.

Tech Highlights:

  • TypeScript
  • MongoDB
  • Web scraping
  • Previously available at: http://cc.rauln.com
  • TypeDoc available at: https://raulnegron.me/cc-api/

manjares-bot

Slack bot for posting the menu of our office’s café daily.

Tech Highlights:

  • Python
  • Slack bot
  • Web scraping

django-profanity-check

Replace bad words with asterisks in your Django templates.

Tech Highlights:

  • Reusable Django App
  • Available on PyPI and Django Packages

muncipios-api

Get adjacency and distance information on Puerto Rico’s 78 municipalities.

Tech Highlights:

  • AWS Lambda
  • Flask
  • Available at: https://municipios.rauln.com

smash-tourney

My first “open-source” software. A Super Smash Bros. tourney organizer featuring the famous “VERSUS” announcers!

Tech Highlights:

  • Text-to-Speech
  • Available on PyPI

Other open-source projects I've worked on

  • notaso - Migrated to Django 2, testing, bug fixes, maintenance.

  • 1hora - Migrated to Django 2, migrated internal state machine from django-states2 to django-fsm, bug fixes, maintenance.

  • suministrospr - Some query optimizations and migration squashing.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
